Video abstract · 5 min · eLife

Which way is up?

A narrated explainer of how the brain uses gravity, the visual scene and the body to search a tilted world. Based on Chen & Xu, “Allocentric and egocentric cues constitute an internal reference frame for real-world visual search.”

Chapters

    Transcript

    The VR scene and objects are the study’s own stimuli, and the flight simulator is drawn from the lab’s CAD models of the base and cabin. Charts are redrawn from the means plotted in the manuscript’s Figures 2 and 6. The narration is a synthesized voice (Kokoro, af_heart), so it can be swapped for an author voice-over that follows this transcript.
